_meta.engine: PSS-012 Business Reference Data (BusinessReferenceDataSet/Version/Value; TenantScopedEntity; SetCode unique per tenant).
_meta.authoring_path: Gateway 5000 /api/v1/reference-data: create-set -> add values -> validate -> submit -> approve -> publish; OR POST /imports/preview + POST /imports/{previewId}/commit (Idempotency-Key required). MOD-0048 publish is OUT OF SCOPE for the plan that produced this file.
_meta.value_schema: BusinessReferenceDataValue { valueCode, displayName, sortOrder, isDeprecated, parentValueCode?, attributes{} }. 'description' is carried under attributes (not a first-class field).
rules: ValueCode stable, lowercase kebab-case, no magic numbers.
DisplayName here is en-US; MOD-0048 value model carries a single displayName — 7-locale display is consumer-side RESX (key: ReferenceValue.<setCode>.<valueCode>).
Referenced values are never hard-deleted -> set isDeprecated=true; deprecated values not selectable for new create/update; historical values remain displayable.
No CRM local seed / hardcoded fallback; MOD-0048/PSS-012 is the SoR. An unpublished runtime-required set is a fail-closed 400.
Sets with _status 'blocked-pending-reconciliation' MUST NOT be published until the named follow-up (F1/F2) is resolved with the boundary owner/EA.
